key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:51D2
name: mask_rows_with_lookup_table
description: Walks a destination buffer word by word, ANDing each word with an entry from a 16-entry lookup table indexed by a rolling offset. It advances the row and table offsets as it goes, calls helper routines once per completed group, and stops after all groups are done.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5250
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing but return immediately, so it works only as an empty placeholder entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5258
name: drain_port_until_type_match
description: Repeatedly takes a message from a port through a library call and hands it back through another call, stopping once a message whose type code is 104 arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5262
name: poll_port_set_done_flag
description: Takes messages from a port in a loop, returning each one through a second library call, and sets a completion flag when a message of type 104 is seen. The loop runs until that flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:538A
name: open_graphics_and_intuition_libs
description: Opens graphics.library and then intuition.library and stores both handles. If graphics fails it reports the error; if intuition fails it closes the graphics handle first and then reports the error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:543E
name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens a screen, then a window on it, and closes the screen if the window cannot be opened, reporting the failure text. It then fetches a port from the window, copies 5 bytes into a structure, and copies a 250-byte block into a buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5538
name: copy_32_bytes_from_argument
description: Passes a 32-byte count to a library copy routine, using the argument as the source and a stored window pointer as the destination.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5554
name: copy_32_bytes_fixed_slot
description: Passes a 32-byte count to a library copy routine, using a fixed slot in the program data as the source and a stored window pointer as the destination.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5570
name: close_window_then_screen
description: Closes the stored window handle and then the stored screen handle, in that order.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:558C
name: close_intuition_then_graphics_libs
description: Closes the two library handles opened at startup, the second one first and then the first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:55A8
name: write_decimal_digits_to_buffer
description: Writes a number as ASCII decimal digits into a buffer and returns the position after the last digit. A zero value writes a single '0' character.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:55BC
name: write_digit_advance_cursor
description: Converts a stored value through two helper calls and writes one ASCII digit at the buffer position held in a structure. It then advances that position and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:55F6
name: build_active_index_tables
description: Scans 64 flag bytes and, for each set flag, records its index in one table and the reverse mapping in another. It calls a helper with the matching data word each time, and advances its source pointer every 8 flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:569A
name: scale_and_round_point_offset
description: Subtracts one 16-bit coordinate pair from another and stores each component as a rounded value of the difference multiplied by a factor and divided by a divisor. Negative differences take a separate rounding path.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5726
name: scale_point_from_record
description: Computes scaled X and Y positions from a base point and offsets stored in a record. It uses the same rounded multiply-and-divide as the delta scaler, but reads its inputs from the record instead of arguments.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:577A
name: scale_point_y_component
description: Computes the scaled Y coordinate of a point from record offsets, rounding the product of the offset and factor divided by the divisor.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:57A8
name: record_event_with_slot_state
description: Stores an event in a 32-slot ring buffer and links it into the chain for its type. Type 5 events update a small state byte, other events except type 8 set a flag keyed by the low bits of the data byte, and type 3 events with a changed value trigger two follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:57DE
name: record_event_from_record_fields
description: Appends an event to the same 32-slot ring buffer and per-type chain, taking its type and data from inputs and a record. A type 3 event whose value changed also triggers follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:57F4
name: record_event_flag_and_chain
description: Sets a flag for the event's low data bits unless the event is type 8, then writes the event into the 32-slot ring buffer and links it into its type chain. A type 3 event with a changed value triggers follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5856
name: append_event_to_type_chain
description: Walks the chain of events for a given type to its last entry, links the new entry after it, and writes the event fields into the next free ring-buffer slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5872
name: link_event_into_slot_chain
description: Writes an event's type, data and two record fields into the ring slot at the current index, then links it into the chain for the given slot. A type 3 event whose value changed also triggers follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:58DC
name: wrap_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, acting as a thin pass-through wrapper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:58F2
name: record_event_advance_ring
description: Advances the 32-slot event ring index and writes an event record into the new slot, then updates a state byte for type 5 events or a flag for other events except type 8. It returns the new ring index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:596A
name: store_masked_table_value
description: Looks up a table byte selected by the argument, keeps its low three bits, and stores that value in a state byte. It returns the current value of a second status byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:5980
name: set_flag_for_table_entry
description: Unless the first argument is 8, takes the low three bits of a table entry selected by the second argument, subtracts one, and sets the flag at that position to 1. It returns a status byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:59B6
name: activate_slot_by_type
description: Activates a slot by allocating a node and running one of eight type-specific setup branches. The branches set coordinates and table pointers, update shared counters and flags, and may trigger follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:611A
name: append_node_to_list
description: Appends a node to the end of a singly linked list whose head pointer is stored in program data, clears the node's link field, and returns the list's previous head.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6134
name: append_node_to_tail
description: Walks a linked list to its last node, links the given node after it, and clears the node's link field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6140
name: link_node_after_predecessor
description: Stores a pointer to the second node in the first node's link field and clears the second node's link field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6150
name: unlink_node_from_list
description: Finds the given node in a linked list whose head is in program data, points its predecessor at the node's successor, and then passes the node to a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6186
name: process_active_entries
description: Walks the list of active entries and calls the handler for each entry's type, one of eight kinds, clearing entries whose handler reports completion and running a follow-up routine while the slot still has a successor. It returns 1 when the list is empty and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6290
name: advance_sequence_playback_step
description: Steps a node through a sentinel-terminated sequence table, counting its entries on first use. It returns 1 once the step count reaches the total after applying the final position, and otherwise advances the step and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:62B2
name: step_sequence_node_frame
description: Advances a node through a sentinel-terminated frame table in the same way as the playback step routine, applying the frame coordinates and returning 1 when the table is exhausted and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:62E0
name: start_sequence_playback
description: Starts playback for a node by counting its sentinel-terminated sequence entries, storing the count and first table pointer, and marking playback active. It then sets the node's position from the first coordinates and clears a completion field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6306
name: start_fixed_length_playback
description: Starts playback for a node with a fixed sequence length of 8 instead of counting entries. It sets the first coordinates and clears the node's completion field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6326
name: set_node_sequence_position
description: Takes the next entry from a table, computes its position through a helper, and clears the node's completion field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:638E
name: advance_node_frame_index
description: Advances a node through its frame list one step at a time and updates its position from the frame table. It returns 0 while frames remain and 1 once the position for the last frame has been set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:63C8
name: step_node_frame_with_helper
description: Advances the node's frame index, refreshes its coordinates through helper routines that look up the frame data, and records the node's completion flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:648E
name: mark_node_done
description: Sets the node's completion field to 1 and writes the current list cursor back to the node.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6712
name: draw_numbered_text_panel
description: Builds a header line from a count-derived prefix and the text 'Quartex 1988:', then draws it with text entries taken from embedded tables. The count comes from the number of line-break markers in an embedded data block, halved and increased by one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6A04
name: step_sequence_with_restart
description: Advances a node through a sentinel-terminated sequence, restarting from the table entry when no cursor is stored and counting the entries on first use. It returns 1 once the step count reaches the stored total, and otherwise saves the advanced cursor and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6A34
name: advance_sequence_return_active
description: Walks a node through a sentinel-terminated sequence of positions, counting and restarting the table when no cursor is stored. It applies the next position through helpers and returns true while steps remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6A68
name: restart_sequence_and_step
description: Counts the entries of a sentinel-terminated sequence from its current start, sets the node's step bound to that count, and applies the first position through helper routines. It reports whether the sequence still has steps left.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6A82
name: step_sequence_fixed_bound
description: Starts a sentinel-terminated sequence with a step bound equal to its argument halved, applies the first position through helper routines, and reports whether any steps remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6B0A
name: advance_sequence_mark_complete
description: Advances a node by one step using its stored coordinate and a helper routine, sets its completion field to 1, and reports whether the sequence still has steps left.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6BA6
name: save_cursor_and_return_zero
description: Writes the node's current sequence cursor back into the node and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6BB0
name: advance_sequence_with_delay
description: Advances a node through table positions, holding it in place for a countdown before each step. It returns 1 once the sequence reaches the sentinel value of 65535, and otherwise saves the cursor and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6BD0
name: advance_sequence_to_sentinel
description: Steps a node through a sentinel-terminated sequence, applying the next entry's position through helper routines. It returns 1 once the sentinel has been reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6C30
name: apply_sequence_position_step
description: Applies the node's current sequence position through helper routines, sets its completion flag, and returns 1 when the sequence has no further entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:6C90
name: save_cursor_state_return_zero
description: Writes the node's current sequence cursor back into the node and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:71CC
name: run_command_stream_step
description: Runs a command stream held behind a pointer: each high-bit command byte and its argument byte are passed to a handler selected by the low four bits of the command. When an end marker is reached the next byte loads a countdown, and the routine returns 1 after a step and 0 while the countdown runs.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:71E8
name: run_command_stream_no_countdown
description: Processes high-bit command pairs from a stream like its sibling routine but without the countdown check. It always loads the next countdown byte and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7246
name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Reads the next byte of a stream into a countdown field, or clears the field when the end marker is hit. It always returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:725A
name: fetch_stream_byte_unchecked
description: Reads the next byte from a stream pointer into a field, advances the pointer by one, and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7268
name: clear_countdown_field
description: Clears a countdown field in a structure and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7272
name: refresh_grid_square_record
description: Redraws a grid square described by a small record, first repainting a derived neighbour square when the record is marked. It then clears the record's pending entry for that square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:72DA
name: refresh_grid_square_pair
description: Computes the grid square for a record given by pointer and redraws it through helper routines, clearing its pending entry. It also redraws a second square when the record's kind is 6 and its flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7604
name: query_square_flag_bit
description: Computes a grid index from a packed coordinate, reads that square's byte from a table, and passes its high bit and the index to a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7660
name: store_square_state
description: Writes a square's state byte by combining a code derived from the argument fields with the low bits of the first argument. It also stores a second per-square value and calls a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:774E
name: clear_buffer_and_capture_value
description: Zeroes a 512-entry buffer, reads a value through a library call, stores it, and adds the difference between two readings to a running counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:77D2
name: check_flag_and_store
description: Checks a condition flag: when it is set, it returns half of a helper's result. Otherwise it stores that result and a second value into a table indexed by a register, then returns the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:77FC
name: accumulate_counter_when_matched
description: When the low bit of a flag word is set and two supplied values are equal, adds their difference to a running counter and calls a helper. Otherwise the inputs are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:783E
name: assemble_byte_from_bits
description: Builds an 8-bit value one bit at a time: each pass shifts the accumulator left, calls a helper, and sets the lowest bit when the shifted value was non-zero. The result is not returned to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7852
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Builds a two-level Huffman decoding table in a local buffer from 256 code-length and value word pairs, filling direct entries for codes up to eight bits and second-level entries for longer codes. It then copies the finished table into the shared table area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7922
name: decode_huffman_symbols
description: Decodes up to a requested number of symbols from a bit stream using the decoding table, writing each decoded byte to the output. It returns the count, limited by the remaining size.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7A3A
name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7A4C
name: advance_counter_or_read_word
description: Returns an input word read through a pointer. When its flag argument is zero, it first adds a fixed step of 512 units to a running counter and calls a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7A94
name: decode_symbol_run_with_length
description: Decodes a counted run of symbols from the bit stream using the decoding table, with the count taken from a word argument. It saves the decoder state afterwards and may write a padding zero byte at the end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7BD8
name: prime_bit_reader_from_stream
description: Clears a status word, calls a helper, and reads the next byte or word from a stream pointer depending on alignment. It stores the value together with a bit mask derived from its argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7C1A
name: accumulate_counter_difference
description: Computes the difference between two pointer values, offset by 512 units, adds it to a running counter, and calls a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7C34
name: initialise_buffer_and_clear_state
description: Initialises a buffer through a library call with a fixed value, runs three helper routines, and clears a state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7C5A
name: dispatch_state_handler
description: Calls a helper, then selects one of three helpers from a stored state value: states 0 and 1 each call their own helper, and state 2 calls a third. Other values return the state minus two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7C8C
name: enable_flags_and_run_setup
description: Sets two status words to 1 and calls a helper. When a mode word is zero it runs two extra helpers, then calls a final helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7CCE
name: shift_history_and_push
description: Shifts a history of 8-byte entries by one slot to make room, writes the current pair of words into the newest slot, and resets the entry count to -1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7D3C
name: remove_history_front_entry
description: Decrements the history count and shifts the 8-byte entries down by one slot, then writes the current pair of words into the top slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7D96
name: reset_playback_state
description: Resets several counters and status words, sets one counter to 200 or 0 depending on a flag byte, and calls helper routines. It maps the stored index values 0, 1 and 2 to new states 0, 2 and 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7E28
name: run_eight_pass_setup
description: Calls a helper once, then runs four helper calls in each of eight passes. Finally it resets a stored index to 0 and sets a flag to 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:7EBA
name: reset_history_count
description: Sets the history entry count to -1 and saves the current pair of words into a second location.

name: count_entries_until_false
description: Counts backwards through the history entries from the current index, stopping at the first entry where a helper test fails, and returns the number counted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A2A2
name: scan_history_for_pattern
description: Scans the history entries backwards, comparing stored values and calling a helper on each position. It returns a small count of the steps matched before the scan ends.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A480
name: read_word_before_pointer
description: Returns the 16-bit word stored two bytes before the base pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A488
name: validate_move_candidate
description: Checks a candidate move between two positions, choosing among three validity tests by the kind value. It returns a flag along with a second value, and the tests look at the midpoint, a stored path or stored target values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A76E
name: append_candidate_entry
description: Appends the current position pair to a list of candidate entries if fewer than 80 are stored.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A79C
name: scan_kinds_two_to_five
description: Sets an enabled flag, calls a helper for each kind value from 2 to 5, and then clears the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A7C8
name: collect_target_candidates
description: Collects candidate target squares for the current entry by checking its adjacent offsets and walking its stored direction list. Each valid target is recorded through helper routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:A9A2
name: generate_moves_by_kind
description: Generates target squares by kind: kind 1 and kind 5 each step through eight offsets, kind 6 uses one offset with a bounds check, and kinds 2 to 4 step along directions until blocked. Each generated target is passed to helper routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:ABBE
name: collect_candidates_for_both_sides
description: Resets the candidate counters, collects the targets of each entry on both sides through helper routines, and for a kind-6 entry with a high value tests the squares around the midpoint of its span.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:AE1C
name: pop_next_candidate
description: Returns the next stored candidate pair while any remain, otherwise returns the fallback pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:AE58
name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the lowest bit of the argument's low 16-bit value as a 16-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:AE68
name: evaluate_board_position
description: Scores the board position: it totals a value for each occupied square from a kind table, builds per-side weight tables over the board grid, and combines them into the result. It runs to about 960 instructions and calls five helper routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:BC08
name: count_helper_true_bits
description: Shifts a 16-bit value right one bit at a time, calling a helper for each bit, and returns how many helper calls returned non-zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:BC36
name: compute_negated_weighted_sum
description: Calls a helper three times and returns the negation of their weighted sum, with weights 8, 20 and 40 in that order.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:BCC4
name: lookup_weighted_table_entry
description: Computes a table index from three arguments and returns the sum of an entry at that index and a second table entry selected by the first argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:BD0A
name: update_masks_return_difference
description: Stores the inverted mask of the second argument's value and updates a pair of 16-bit mask words for the current depth. It then returns the difference between two helper results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:BDE6
name: update_masks_pair_difference
description: Updates two 16-bit mask words for the current depth from the first argument's value and the inverted mask of the second argument, then returns the difference between two helper results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:BF2C
name: score_move_delta
description: Computes the score change for a move from the moving kind, the square terms in a table, and a helper value. Its second argument, when non-zero, adds a fixed adjustment, and the routine returns the difference between two helper results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C198
name: run_search_iterations
description: Runs a search over up to a limit of plies, generating moves and updating the best value and depth in the search state. It starts from a sentinel bound of 32767 and loops until a limit or cutoff flag ends the search.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C300
name: check_elapsed_within_budget
description: Returns 0 when a search flag is clear. Otherwise it returns 0 while the elapsed counter is below its budget and a side flag equals 1, and 1 in all other cases.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C33A
name: locate_kind_six_per_side
description: Clears a table of 8-byte entries, sets two index words to -1, then scans each side's squares for kind-6 entries and records the index found for each side.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C41C
name: start_search_with_value
description: Sets a flag from a stored byte, clears a counter, calls a helper with its argument, and stores the result as the best value when the counter is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C46E
name: unrecovered_routine_four_callees
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available and the behaviour cannot be recovered from the evidence. The routine has 122 instructions, calls four routines and is called by two routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C604
name: expand_search_node
description: Expands one search node by copying its pending entries into the search list, running helper tests on each candidate, and tracking the node's stage through the values 1, 2 and 3. It returns early when a helper test succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:C91A
name: search_position_best_score
description: Searches the current position for its best score: it records the position in the history, generates moves into the search list, applies each through helper routines, and keeps the highest value found. It returns early when a stop flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:CC4A
name: record_search_candidate
description: Stores a candidate value pair in one of two per-depth slots. Helper comparisons decide whether it replaces the first slot or the second, and the old first entry moves down when it is replaced.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:CD30
name: test_pending_candidates
description: Returns 1 when a helper test passes for the current candidate, or for either of the two entries stored for the current depth while the stage value is not 2. Otherwise it returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:CDEC
name: update_bound_if_within_limit
description: Returns 1 when the argument does not exceed a stored limit, and raises a stored maximum to the argument when the argument is larger. Otherwise it returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:CE26
name: process_search_node_step
description: Processes one search step at the current depth: it sets the node's remaining count, updates the stored values and candidate lists through helpers, and returns 1 when the search can stop at this node or 0 to continue.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:D28E
name: score_depth_one_node
description: Returns 1 early when a stored count is above 2 at depth one. At depth one it weights two values into two stored counters, and at deeper levels it returns 1 when a helper result exceeds 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:D374
name: record_search_result_at_depth
description: Copies the current candidate pair into the search table for this depth. At depth zero it also records the bound, and for a particular kind value it stores the current value as the bound.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:D3E4
name: try_kinds_two_to_five
description: Marks the current depth as active, calls a helper for each kind value from 2 to 5, and returns 1 as soon as one call succeeds. Otherwise it clears the depth flag and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:D45A
name: test_moves_for_entry
description: Records the entry as the current candidate, then tests its neighbouring squares for matching kind-6 entries and walks its stored direction list. It calls helpers for each target and returns 1 as soon as a helper test succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:D6D2
name: test_targets_by_kind
description: Generates target squares for the current entry by kind and tests each one through helper routines, returning 1 as soon as a test succeeds. Kinds 1 and 5 step through eight offsets, kinds 2 to 4 slide until blocked, and kind 6 uses one offset with a bounds check and a path test.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:DAF2
name: check_direction_pairs
description: Walks a list of direction pairs from the stored index downward. It returns 1 as soon as one pair passes a helper test followed by a second helper test, and 0 when the list is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:DBE6
name: test_midpoint_squares
description: For a kind-6 entry at the previous depth with a value above 31, marks the current depth as kind 6 and tests the squares around the midpoint of its span through helpers. It returns 1 when a square passes both helper tests, otherwise 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:DD7E
name: unwind_history_and_swap
description: Steps back through the history one entry at a time, swapping the two stored index values and passing each saved entry to a helper. When a flag is set it passes one more entry to the helper at the end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:DDFE
name: replay_history_forward
description: Replays saved history forward from the current depth to the saved depth, passing each entry to a helper and swapping the two stored index values after each step. When a flag is set it first passes one extra entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:DE7A
name: show_jay_was_wrong_message
description: Stores a helper result as a result flag and, when a pending state word is non-zero, shows the 'Jay was wrong #1' message if a second flag is clear. Otherwise it clears the state word and sets the result flag to 1 when the state was 2.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:E084
name: encode_move_commands
description: Encodes a move from a source square to a target square as a sequence of helper calls with code and argument pairs, with the pairs chosen by piece kind and by the direction between the squares. The decompiled text is cut off partway through, so the remaining branches are not described here.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:F17C
name: initialise_two_table_slots
description: Initialises two stored values by calling a helper with a table pointer and a constant index, first 7 and then 8, and saving each result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:F1B4
name: call_helpers_when_flag_clear
description: When a status word is zero, calls two helper routines. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:F1D4
name: write_command_record
description: When a status word is non-zero, writes a command record of several words into the output buffer. The record holds a code for the first or second variant, coordinates computed from the first argument and an offset, a stored byte, and a closing marker.
